area: First zone after the prologue: Apeman Facility (Monitoring, Elevator) + Baichang, New Kunlun Central Hall, Four Seasons Pavilion (hub), Central Transport Hub up to Tai-Chi Kick
boundary: From the elevator down out of Peach Blossom Village (end of the prologue) to the Anomalous Root Node in the Central Transport Hub where Lear teaches Tai-Chi Kick. The zone boss is Red Tiger Elite Baichang (first boss-bar fight, gates the zone); the first new skills are Mystic Nymph (Pavilion) and Tai-Chi Kick (CTH). The first Sol (General Yingzhao) is 4 more scenes and ~1 h further (Power Reservoir E/C, Radiant Pagoda) and is left out, as its own zone.

units.native: Unity units (1 tile = 16 units; positions in scene space)
units.how: files: the gameplay SceneCamera is perspective, FOV 68 deg (vertical), 240 units in front of the play plane (CameraCore z = -240; every CamBound trigger also sets FOV 68). Visible play plane = 2*240*tan(34 deg) = 323.8 units tall, 575.6 wide at 16:9, so 1920 px / 575.6 = 3.336 of our px per unit. Cross-check: the earlier mined estimate (view = 200 map px; AFM 5888 units = 2067 map px) gives 570 units, 1% off. Scenes are placed as on the in-game world map: each scene shifted by an offset fitted on saves, chests and doors against the mined map (+-50 px), with one scale for all scenes; transitions between scenes are not physical distances.

hero.boxNote: files: PPlayer BoxCollider2D 10 x 30 units (offset 0,15: feet at the origin) = 33 x 100 of our px; the sprite with ears is taller (~116 px)
hero.moveNote: files (CatanaStat + MaxRun): MaxRun 150 u/s, RunAccel 650, JumpSpeed 255 u/s, VariableJumpTime 0.133 s, Gravity 830, MaxFall 320 (fast fall 470), DashSpeed 300 u/s, WallRunSpeed 150, roll stamina 2. Jump height = 255*0.133 + 255^2/(2*830) = 73 units = 244 px if the hold keeps full speed for the variable-jump time (Celeste-style controller); about 39 units (131 px) on a tap. In our px: run 500 px/s, dash 1000 px/s.
startAbilities: Wall Climb (on climbable walls) + wall jump
